_note: All values sourced from uscis.gov. Any value that could not be confirmed from an official uscis.gov source is set to null with needsVerification: true. No values are guessed. Category weights are not included.

civicsTestVersionSelection._description: Which civics test an applicant takes, chosen by the date Form N-400 was filed. Filed before the boundary date: 2008 test. Filed on or after the boundary date: 2025 test.

boundaryDate.sourceQuote: Aliens who file Form N-400 to apply for naturalization before Oct. 20, 2025, will take the 2008 naturalization civics test. Aliens who file Form N-400 to apply for naturalization on or after Oct. 20, 2025, will take the 2025 naturalization civics test.

englishTest._description: English reading and writing portion of the naturalization test. Applies to all applicants regardless of civics test version.

sentencesPresented.sourceQuote: For the reading test, you must read out loud 1 of 3 sentences correctly to demonstrate an ability to read in English.

sentencesToPassCount.sourceQuote: For the reading test, you must read out loud 1 of 3 sentences correctly to demonstrate an ability to read in English.

sentencesPresented.sourceQuote: For the writing test, you must write 1 out of 3 sentences correctly to demonstrate an ability to write in English.

sentencesToPassCount.sourceQuote: For the writing test, you must write 1 out of 3 sentences correctly to demonstrate an ability to write in English.

2008._description: 2008 Civics Test. Applies to Form N-400 filed before October 20, 2025.

questionPoolSize.sourceQuote: The USCIS officer will ask you up to 10 questions from the list of 100 civics test questions.

questionsAsked.sourceQuote: The USCIS officer will ask you up to 10 questions from the list of 100 civics test questions.

passingScore.sourceQuote: You must answer 6 questions correctly to pass the 2008 naturalization civics test.

earlyStopOnCorrect.sourceQuote: Officers will stop asking questions when an alien answers 6 questions correctly or 5 questions incorrectly.

earlyStopOnIncorrect.sourceQuote: Officers will stop asking questions when an alien answers 6 questions correctly or 5 questions incorrectly.

2025._description: 2025 Civics Test. Applies to Form N-400 filed on or after October 20, 2025.

questionPoolSize.sourceQuote: The 2025 Naturalization Civics Test is an oral test consisting of 20 questions from the list of 128 civics test questions.

questionsAsked.sourceQuote: The 2025 Naturalization Civics Test is an oral test consisting of 20 questions from the list of 128 civics test questions.

passingScore.sourceQuote: You must answer 12 questions correctly to pass the 2025 Naturalization Civics Test.

earlyStopOnCorrect.sourceQuote: Officers will stop asking questions when an alien answers 12 questions correctly, or 9 questions incorrectly.

earlyStopOnIncorrect.sourceQuote: Officers will stop asking questions when an alien answers 12 questions correctly, or 9 questions incorrectly.

65_20_specialConsideration._description: 65/20 Special Consideration: for applicants aged 65+ who have been a lawful permanent resident for 20+ years at the time of filing. They take a 10-question civics test drawn from the 20 specially designated (asterisked) questions of the 2008 or 2025 test, chosen by the filing date, and may take it in their language of choice with an interpreter. Designated ids: data/civics-65-20.json.

eligibilityAgeMinimum.sourceQuote: An officer gives special consideration to an alien who is 65 years of age or older and who has been living in the United States for periods totaling at least 20 years subsequent to a lawful admission for permanent residence.
eligibilityAgeMinimum._note: The Policy Manual adds: "The age and time requirements must be met at the time of filing the naturalization application." The Study for the Test page states the same rule in plainer words.

eligibilityResidencyYearsMinimum.sourceQuote: An officer gives special consideration to an alien who is 65 years of age or older and who has been living in the United States for periods totaling at least 20 years subsequent to a lawful admission for permanent residence.
eligibilityResidencyYearsMinimum._note: The Policy Manual adds: "The age and time requirements must be met at the time of filing the naturalization application." The Study for the Test page states the same rule in plainer words.

questionBank.sourceQuote: The bank of civics test questions for aliens given special consideration contains 20 specially designated civics questions to study.

questionsAsked.sourceQuote: The civics test for aliens given special consideration contains 10 questions.

passingScore.sourceQuote: An alien who meets the criteria for special consideration passes the civics test if he or she provides a correct answer or provides an alternative phrasing of the correct answer for at least six of 10 civics test questions from the specially designated list of 20 questions.

earlyStopOnCorrect._note: No saved USCIS source states an early-stop rule for the 65/20 test (checked: Policy Manual Vol. 12 Part E Ch. 2 and 3, Study for the Test, 2025 Civics Test page, Exceptions and Accommodations, both official lists). The stop rules in the Policy Manual are stated for the standard 2008 and 2025 tests. The practice asks all 10 questions.

earlyStopOnIncorrect._note: No saved USCIS source states an early-stop rule for the 65/20 test (checked: Policy Manual Vol. 12 Part E Ch. 2 and 3, Study for the Test, 2025 Civics Test page, Exceptions and Accommodations, both official lists). The stop rules in the Policy Manual are stated for the standard 2008 and 2025 tests. The practice asks all 10 questions.

languageChoicePermitted.sourceQuote: Aliens may take the civics test in their language of choice using an interpreter.
